description: Run an OCPI charging journey against a sandbox endpoint. Answers: how do I try a journey without an endpoint of my own.

retryKey.description: A key of your choosing for this run. Calling again with the same key returns the run it started instead of starting another. Omit it to start a new run on every call.

templateId.description: Journey to run, from chargerdojo_list_journey_templates. Omit to run the shortest one that fits a sandbox endpoint.

name: chargerdojo_run_sandbox_journey
title: Run a sandbox journey
